QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Who's That Lady?
QuestInfo.0: With the Lupos out of the picture, you returned to your goal of unmasking the Robed Lady, but she doesn't seem to think it's such a great idea.
QuestInfo.1: With the Lupos out of the picture, you returned to your goal of unmasking the Robed Lady, but she doesn't seem to think it's such a great idea. Leon doubled down on his reward to try and entice her.
QuestInfo.2: With the Lupos out of the picture, you returned to your goal of unmasking the Robed Lady, and Leon's reward worked! Claire Tremier, the daughter of Vaughn Tremier, revealed herself as the Robed Lady!
